newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bridgestone in A$41 mln division sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bridgestone in A$41 mln division sale.

text.p: Industrial products group Bridgestone Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it would sell its automotive components division into a joint venture company between itself and Japan's Toyoda Gosei Co.
Bridgestone said the purchase price was about A$41 million.

The joint venture, to be known as Bridgestone TG Australia Pty Ltd, will be owned 60 percent by Bridgestone Australia and 40 percent by Toyoda Gosei, which in turn is 40 percent owned by Toyota Motor Corp.
The sale is subject to shareholder approval but is expected to be effective January 1, 1997, with completion expected by January 30.
Bridgestone Australia said Toyoda Gosei was one of the world's largest and most technologically advanced manufacturers of automotive components.
Of the purchase price, about A$13.5 million was for real estate at Edwardstown in South Australia, the company said.

While Bridgestone TG Australia was currently a wholly owned subsidiary of Bridgstone Australia, Bridgestone Australia said Toyoda Gosei would make a cash subscription of A$6 million in the capital of Bridgestone TG Australia while Bridgestone would increase its shareholding to A$9 million by way of a cash subscription.

Bridgestone said the joint venture would also have access to a loan facility of approximately A$35 million from a bank or other lending institution to enable it to complete the purchase and to provide working capital.
Bridgestone shares closed steady at A$3.20 on turnover of 2,000 shares.
